title: Digging Deeper: Conversations in Fundamental Investing
description: A panel discussion at Sohn 2026 featuring a group of experienced investors— Andrew Bellas, Eduardo Marques, David Rosen, and Jonathan Lennon —moderated by Mitch Golden. The conversation focuses on investment strategies within the current market environment, including the impacts of AI and the persistence of value investing.
summary: The video argues that several semiconductor and technology stocks offer significant value, citing Micron and SK Hynix as massive cash generators trading at low multiples. It suggests that SK Square provides a discounted entry point to SK Hynix, while Samsung Life and Samsung Electronics are highlighted as undervalued holdings within the broader Samsung ecosystem. Additionally, the pitch identifies Reddit, Viatris, and Carvana as high-upside opportunities driven by AI potential, drug pipeline rescheduling, and strong growth projections, respectively.

claims.claim: Samsung Life is a holding company for Samsung Electronics, trading at 0.48 book value and four times earnings.
claims.quote: I think uh the one we're most excited about recently is a company called Samsung Life. And this is specially convoluted. Samsung Life is is like the name says at first glance just a regular insurance company that does life and health insurance in Korea. But it turns out that it's actually the holding company through which the Lee family controls about 10% of Samsung Electronics. And obviously it's Samsung Electronics is the company that just reached a trillion-dollar market cap. It's a DRAM and and NAND powerhouse. It makes the phones we see and the televisions, etc. And so, that business today, you know, Samsung Electronics trades for about seven times current-year earnings. And and that's actually excluding about uh half of their memory, I'm sorry, half of their um uh microprocessing business is in fact a foundry, sort of like the Intel or the TSMC business, that today is operating at zero margin. And so, if only they can fix that, we can have like a Intel-like boom to to Samsung Electronics. And and my point is that owning Samsung Electronics through the life insurance company gets you to a massive discount. And how massive? Obviously, like this is a this is a bit of like a Berkshire Hathaway question, you know, you're owning uh an insurance company and you're trading the underlying parts. But in this case, the easiest way to see this is that um if you just mark to market the Samsung Electronics shares that that the life company owns, you're buying life at 0.48, you know, a little under 50% of its book value. And and if you just take the dividends that Samsung is going to produce next year and run them through the net income of of the life insurance company, you're buying it at about four times earnings.
claims.speaker: Eduardo

claims.claim: Reddit could double or triple from here if put in an AI winning basket, trading at 14 times next year earnings.
claims.quote: Reddit shares are down almost 50% from the highs. Um you know, sometimes when we approach investing on the long side, we think about the thing we'd be the the scaredest to be short just behaviorally and it would be at the very top of my list. I think um that the the total posts and comments on on on Reddit have have grown from like 24 billion in 4Q to 25 billion this quarter. Um there is a probably a behavioral inflection that will occur in the back half of this year where the licensing agreements that they have with Google um and, you know, at least with Open AI, you know, will be repriced. Our work suggests they could reprice on an Apple Apple's basis at like 5 or 6X and then there will be a massive shift at that moment in perception. At the same time, Reddit is in a, you know, in a you know, in a in a lawsuit with Anthropic. You know, the outcome of that will be either great for Reddit or amazing for Reddit. You know, you can only choose one. And and at the same time they're monetizing, right? Meta's RPU is like 70, Reddit's is in the low 20s. We have them growing revenues over 50% earnings over 75% and it's like 14 times our next year earnings number closer to 10 times looking out to 2028. If all of a sudden this gets put in an AI winning basket, it's you know, between a double and triple, you know, from here.
